Passive "Ink Splash": Increases the wearer's DEF by [#1: 48%/60%/72%/84%/96%]. description:
Light cone: In the Night
Passive "Flowers and Butterflies": Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by [#1: 18%/21%/24%/27%/30%]. While the wearer is in battle, for every [#2: 10] SPD that exceeds 100, increases DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill by [#3: 6%/7%/8%/9%/10%]. At the same time, increases the CRIT DMG of Ultimate by [#4: 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%]. This effect can stack up to [#5: 6] time(s).
